title: The Friday 4:30 PM Sync Evader
prompt: Decline an invite to a 4:30 PM Friday sync from your skip-level manager. You are not going. Sound enthusiastic, protect your weekend, and use corporate meeting speak. Avoid plain negative words!
hint: Try using phrases like: 'hard stop', 'bandwidth', 'circle back', 'take this offline', 'touch base', or 'parking lot'.

title: The Lethal Paper Trail
prompt: A coworker asked for a file that was attached to an email you sent yesterday. Write a passive-aggressive email ensuring they know they failed to read it, without directly insulting them.
hint: Try using phrases like: 'per my last email', 'friendly reminder', 'attaching for your visibility', 'as discussed', or 'looping in'.

title: The Performance Review Reframe
prompt: Explain why the entire quarterly launch was missed without admitting fault. Reframe the disaster as strategic visionary flexibility and proactive team evolution.
hint: Try using phrases like: 'agile pivot', 'opportunity for growth', 'growth mindset', 'comfortable with ambiguity', 'wear multiple hats', or 'critical path'.

title: The LinkedIn Phoenix
prompt: You were abruptly let go this morning. Write a viral LinkedIn post reframing this severance event as an inspirational, transcendent milestone. Solicit engagement at the end!
hint: Try using phrases like: 'humbled and thrilled', 'next chapter', 'agree?', 'open to new opportunities', 'paradigm shift', or 'game-changing milestone'.
